# OpenMagnetics Automated Relay Board - Netlist Reference
# Generated by generate_board.py

## Power Nets
- VBUS: USB-C VBUS -> U4 input, C17, C15
- +5V: U4 output -> ULN2003A COM pins, relay coil supply
- +3V3: U4 output -> STM32 VDD, decoupling caps
- GND: Common ground, all ICs, USB shield

## USB Nets
- USB_DP: USB-C D+ -> STM32 PA12 (USB_DP)
- USB_DM: USB-C D- -> STM32 PA11 (USB_DM)
- CC1: USB-C CC1 -> R1 (5.1k) -> GND
- CC2: USB-C CC2 -> R2 (5.1k) -> GND

## GPIO -> Relay Driver Nets
- GPIO0 (PA0) -> U2 pin 1 (IN1) -> U2 pin 16 (OUT1) -> K1 coil-
- GPIO1 (PA1) -> U2 pin 2 (IN2) -> U2 pin 15 (OUT2) -> K2 coil-
- GPIO2 (PA2) -> U2 pin 3 (IN3) -> U2 pin 14 (OUT3) -> K3 coil-
- GPIO3 (PA3) -> U2 pin 4 (IN4) -> U2 pin 13 (OUT4) -> K4 coil-
- GPIO4 (PA4) -> U2 pin 5 (IN5) -> U2 pin 12 (OUT5) -> K5 coil-
- GPIO5 (PA5) -> U2 pin 6 (IN6) -> U2 pin 11 (OUT6) -> K6 coil-
- GPIO6 (PA6) -> U2 pin 7 (IN7) -> U2 pin 10 (OUT7) -> K7 coil-
- GPIO7 (PA7) -> U3 pin 1 (IN1) -> U3 pin 16 (OUT1) -> K8 coil-
- GPIO8 (PB1) -> U3 pin 2 (IN2) -> U3 pin 15 (OUT2) -> K9 coil-
- All relay coil+ -> +5V
- U2 pin 8 = GND, U2 pin 9 = COM (+5V with internal flyback)
- U3 pin 8 = GND, U3 pin 9 = COM (+5V with internal flyback)

## Signal Path Nets (Relay Contacts)
### Port Routing
- K1 (R1): COM1=Bode100_1, NC1=/A, NO1=/C
- K2 (R2): COM1=Bode100_2, NC1=/B, NO1=R3_COM
- K3 (R3): COM1=R3_COM, NC1=/D, NO1=/C

### Cross-Connections
- K4 (R4): COM1=/C, NO1=/D, COM2=/C, NO2=/D  (parallel poles)
- K5 (R5): COM1=/A, NO1=/B, COM2=/A, NO2=/B  (parallel poles)
- K6 (R6): COM1=/B, NO1=/C
- K7 (R7): COM1=/B, NO1=/D
- K8 (R8): COM1=/A, NO1=/C
- K9 (R9): COM1=/A, NO1=/D

## DUT Terminals
- J4: /A (primary input)
- J5: /B (primary output)
- J6: /C (secondary input)
- J7: /D (secondary output)

## Bode100 Connections
- J2: Bode100_2 (left edge pad)
- J3: Bode100_1 (right edge pad)
